date_rules.SWS: rounds with published < O(t) (string compare on ISO dates)
date_rules.news: quarter q used only if its last headline was published before O(t); L=0 -> quarter t, L=1 -> t-1
date_rules.CPI: month m used only from day 10 of month m+1
date_rules.fits: alpha, news lag, phi, rho, Q, scales from training pairs / vintages known at O(t) only
